column1: # BMX Parts Depot term registry. Single source of truth for the A-Z glossary.
# Generated once from content-plan/az-dictionary.md, which is retained as the
# original research record and is no longer read by the build.
# Tab separated. Lines starting with # are comments. Columns:
#   letter         which A-Z group it files under. Editorial, not the first
#                  letter of the name: Wheel Dish files under D.
#   slug           the anchor id. Must match a "## Heading {#slug}" on `home`.
#   term           display name in the A-Z.
#   category       one of the eight: drivetrain frame wheels steering brakes
#                  cockpit vintage hardware. A category is NOT a pillar:
#                  drivetrain spans pillars 01, 04 and 05, cockpit spans 08
#                  and 09, and hardware is distributed across all ten.
#   home           pillar slug that owns the canonical section.
#   status         published | planned. Only published terms reach the hub,
#   definition     the one-liner rendered in the A-Z and used as the
#   relevance      why it matters to a buyer. Not rendered, kept from the
#   source_status  solid | verify for published terms, risk-low | risk-med |
#                  risk-high for planned ones. risk-high means expect it to
#                  end up in a ::: needsverify block rather than a table.
#   related        pipe separated slugs, for the see-also strips.
